scientific_integrity.claim_scope: All finite matroids, including loops, coloops, disconnected and nonrepresentable cases; binary element-membership concepts of bases; deterministic realizable VC and Littlestone dimensions.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No noisy, randomized, infinite-matroid, arbitrary constant-weight-family or computational implementation claims. Historical publication priority beyond checked primary sources remains uncertain. Independent scientific audit has not occurred.
scientific_integrity.proof_dependencies: Static-shattering characterization from dual bases; Edmonds matroid-intersection min-max theorem; dual-rank formula; deletion/contraction identities; induction on ground-set cardinality.
scientific_integrity.verified_computations: Independent direct enumerations of 498 labeled matroids on ground sets of sizes 0 through 5, and 336 seeded random binary-representable examples with up to 10 elements. Tests confirm four independently evaluated parameters and exact minor splits.

title: A matroid-intersection formula for the online shattering dimension of basis indicators
